set.body:
Source: 2026-07-25 review finding 7.

Problem:
SlurmStateParser.parse (cli/SlurmParsers.scala:441) and SlurmTiming.textTimestamp/textTimeLimit (:526, :562) call toUpperCase with the default locale. On a tr-TR JVM "timeout".toUpperCase is "TIMEOUT" with a dotted capital I, so every state falls through to SlurmState.Unknown and every time limit to ObservedTimeLimit.Unknown.

EnvName.from (core/Identifiers.scala:50) already uses Locale.ROOT, so this is an inconsistency rather than an unrecognized principle.

Acceptance:
- Every locale-sensitive case fold in the CLI parsers uses Locale.ROOT.
- A regression test parses the full state table under a Turkish default locale.
- Sweep for any other default-locale toUpperCase/toLowerCase on parsed external text.
set.title: P6f.34: Use Locale.ROOT in Slurm state and timing text parsing
